name: Draft Angle Analysis + Parallel STEP Import
highlights: Inspect → Draft Angle Analysis classifies every CAD face as positive, negative, requires-draft or straddling for one pull direction and required angle, colors them in the viewport (clipped by the section plane) and exports a full audit CSV

Every STEP assembly now imports on a pool of CAD kernels sized to your machine (up to 12) instead of one single-threaded kernel call — a 40 MB, 189-part truck opens in 13 s instead of 51 s on a 32-thread workstation; each distinct product is tessellated once and placed by transform

One model-wide deflection keeps the triangle budget identical to the whole-document import (Hino: 3,547,084 vs 3,540,844 triangles, same bounds) and the assembly tree keeps every sub-assembly level in source order
The AI Engineer and the Safe Command Palette can run the draft analysis as a validated allow-listed action
The top bar keeps the ProReadyEngineer, Support, AI Engineer and Photoreal buttons fully visible on every laptop width from 1280 px up
